name: 92056 · Oceanside, CA
findings: ZIP 92056 (Oceanside) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92056 (Oceanside) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
